source_policy: Official w-e-st.de product pages and documents only for approved images/specifications; unresolved images remain pending or blocked.
price_policy: No official price file or amount found; use request_quote until W.E.St. provides a price source.

status_definitions.approved_official: Image copied from an official W.E.St. page and optimized without changing product content.
status_definitions.approved_official_multi_product: Official images are shown as a labelled gallery because the page covers multiple official variants/products.
status_definitions.pending_official_confirmation: Existing model-specific image retained, but not promoted to SEO image until W.E.St. confirms the exact variant.
status_definitions.blocked_no_official_image: No suitable official image was found; a neutral non-product placeholder is used instead of a wrong model.
